# Vendored third-party headers

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| httplib.h | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib | v0.63.0 | MIT |
| json.hpp | https://github.com/nlohmann/json | v3.12.0 | MIT |
| doctest.h | https://github.com/doctest/doctest | v2.5.3 | MIT |

| sqlite/sqlite3.c, sqlite3.h | https://sqlite.org | 3.54.1 amalgamation | Public domain |
| librdkafka-2.13.0.tar.gz | https://github.com/confluentinc/librdkafka | v2.13.0 (built from source at build time) | BSD-2-Clause |

System libraries (not vendored): OpenSSL (Apache-2.0), zlib (zlib, optional).
